qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Europe's largest distribution system operator with 1.6 million kilometers of energy networks across Germany and CEE. Regulated asset base (RAB) creates a physically unreplicable natural monopoly with guaranteed regulatory returns under BNetzA oversight.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Massive debt burden & weak interest coverage, REJECT). Dominant European distribution grid operator, but carries economic net debt of €43.2B (net financial debt €32.5B) against net income of €1.73B (18.7x net financial debt / NI). Interest coverage of 2.36x severely breaches the 5.0x threshold, driven by massive continuous grid capex requiring constant debt refinancing.
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 interest expense of €2.20B on EBIT of €5.21B gives interest coverage of only 2.36x. Economic net debt of €43.24B (including pension obligations and AROs) and financial debt of €37.3B tower over net income of €1.73B. Annual capex of €7.94B exceeded operating cash flow of €7.00B.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
